Client facts: we help with the application; the subsidy must be submitted before work begins. FAQ needs at least two items, so I'll base both on these facts without inventing amounts or conditions.

Where to put it: the Storitve page, after the boiler text section (index 4 in sections list: header 0, water 1, heat 2, pump 3, boiler 4), so insert at index 5. Only one FAQ section on the page.

Items:
1. Ali pomagate pri vlogi za subvencijo Eko sklada? Yes, when replacing an oil boiler with a heat pump we help with the application.
2. Kdaj je treba oddati vlogo? Before the start of work. Advice: call before we start.

A possible third one: "Za katera dela pomagate pri vlogi?" is based on the existing site facts (boiler replacement). It's fine, but I'll keep it to two to stay safe.

The tone alternates: boiler is inverse, so the FAQ goes on default, and the next section (bath) is default too. That's acceptable, but I'll use "alt" for the FAQ to differentiate; the following bath is default, so it's fine.
